home.faq1Q: Which vehicles can be imported into Algeria?
home.faq1A: Resident individuals may import a new or used passenger car under 3 years old, petrol, hybrid or electric. Diesel passenger cars may not be imported by individuals.
home.faq2A: The customs value (price, or reference value depreciated by age, + freight + insurance) is converted into dinars. Customs duty is applied according to engine size, then the solidarity contribution (3%), the PRCT levy (2%), and finally 19% VAT on the extended base.
home.faq3Q: What is the décret 23-74 duty reduction?
home.faq3A: For a used vehicle under 3 years old, total duties and taxes are reduced by 80% for electric, 50% for petrol or hybrid up to 1,800 cc, and 20% above that.
home.faq4Q: Can I buy a vehicle tax-free?
home.faq4A: Yes. For export outside the European Union, a vehicle with recoverable VAT can be invoiced excl. VAT upon presentation of proof of export.
home.faq5A: Allow 2 to 4 weeks on average between purchase approval and arrival at the port of Algiers, depending on sailing schedules.
home.ctaTitle: Your dream car is just one crossing away.
home.ctaSubtitle: Tell us what you are looking for: model, budget, colour. We take care of the rest.
home.faq6Q: What if I return for good with a CCR?
home.faq6A: Since the 2026 Finance Act, the CCR (certificate of change of residence) allows you to import a vehicle under 5 years old, petrol, hybrid or electric up to 1,800 cc, exempt from customs duty and VAT. Before departure, chancery fees are paid at the consulate (€40 + €4 per €100 declared, −50% for students), followed by a roadworthiness test in Algeria.

sim.how1: Customs value (CIF) = vehicle price + freight + insurance, converted into dinars.
sim.how2: Customs duty applied to the CIF value according to powertrain and engine size.
sim.how3: 3% solidarity contribution and 2% PRCT levy on the CIF value.
sim.how4: 19% VAT calculated on CIF + customs duty + C.S + PRCT.
sim.how5: Reduction on total duties and taxes for used vehicles under 3 years old.

sim.engineHintCcr: The CCR is limited to {cc} cc (except electric).
sim.referencePriceHint: If customs values the vehicle on its reference price, it removes the foreign VAT (×{coef}), applies age-based depreciation, then uses the higher of the invoice and this value.
sim.ccrDue: Costs to expect with the CCR

about.title: A French car dealer, looking to Europe and the Mediterranean.
about.lead: SKH Global Motors is a French company based in Argenteuil (Val-d’Oise), specialising in buying and selling recent and premium used vehicles. We sell to private and business customers in France and across Europe, and export to Algeria, Tunisia and Morocco.
about.p1: We started from a simple observation: importing a vehicle into Algeria is still too often an opaque process. Price, actual condition, customs rules, shipping… every step comes with its share of uncertainty.
about.p2: Our role is to remove it. We select every car, check its history, estimate customs duties before purchase and arrange transport all the way to Algiers.
about.p3: A subsidiary of Holding SKH, SKH Global Motors sources its vehicles from automotive professionals in France and Europe (ex-lease, ex-fleet and demonstrator cars) to offer the right vehicle at the right price to our French and European customers.
about.v1Desc: Condition, history, price and fees: everything is disclosed before purchase.
about.v2Desc: Invoices, certificates and export documents that meet customs requirements.
about.v3Desc: A dedicated advisor, in French and Arabic, from the first call to delivery.
